description: The article organizes advancements in leadership development research—complex context-influenced learners, leadership as dynamic process, longitudinal non-linear development, multi-level development, and early lifespan development—into a framework mapping each to outcome, assessment, and metric cons
title: Leadership development advancements framework mapping research findings to outcome, assessment, and metric considerations

description: The article uses the learning curve as its central organizing measure for judging surgical training approaches: it \"applies the learning curves as a measure to demonstrate their teaching ability\" and compares simulation types by analyzing their learning curves.
title: Learning-curve analysis for surgical training effectiveness

description: One of two procedures developed at the University of Limburg to reflect \"the extent to which students are able to identify important learning issues given a particular problem\".
title: Learning-issue–objective overlap measure

description: The Learning Study is \"a fusion between lesson study and design experiment\" in which teachers and a researcher jointly plan a lesson around a chosen learning object, implement it with one pupil group, and analyze pre-test, post-test and delayed post-test results together with video-recorded lessons.
title: Learning Study model

description: The review organises outcome measurement for procedural skill learning into three test types.
title: Learning-versus-performance test framework for post-acquisition, retention, and transfer assessment

description: LECTOR (Lecture slides and TOpic Relationships) is an attention-based model that estimates a Matrix of Slide-Topic relationships M from lecture slides.
title: LECTOR (Lecture slides and TOpic Relationships) discourse-based attention model

description: Legitimation Code Theory (LCT) is an explanatory framework for analysing the basis of achievement underlying practices.
title: Legitimation Code Theory specialisation-dimension analytic framework
